items.title: Bitcoin Price Prediction: Where Will BTC Be by 2028?
items.summary: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) is trading at $75,904, a 0.6% drop in the last 24 hours. Over the past month, it has fallen 8.9% and is now 39.8% below its peak of $126,080. Over the past year, BTC has fluctuated, reaching a high of $105,951 on November 10, 2025, and dropping to a low of $58,566 on June 30, 2026. [...] A Bitcoin price above $100,000 by the end of 2028 seems plausible, while hitting $150,000 appears less likely given current conditions. For Bitcoin to gain momentum, it needs to first regain its 50-day moving average of $82,003. From there, it should clear its one-year high of $105,951, supported by ETF inflows and a Fed rate cut from 4.00%. [...] If Bitcoin reaches $100,000, its market cap, calculated by multiplying the price by the number of coins in circulation, would be around $2.01 trillion, based on the current supply of 20,105,365 coins. At its present price, Bitcoin has a market cap of about $1.53 trillion, while the second-largest cryptocurrency, Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH), stands at roughly $272.82 billion.

items.title: Bitcoin knocks on $78,000 as midterm election uncertainty fades
items.summary:
Bitcoin BTC$77,725.53 has erased its early losses and is steaming higher as U.S. midterm election uncertainty fades.

The largest cryptocurrency fell to just under $76,000 early Wednesday as reports said Democrats were sweeping both houses of Congress. It has since staged a V-shaped recovery, erasing its early losses. As of this writing, the cryptocurrency traded 0.5% higher on the day. [...] Summary

Show

   Bitcoin rebounded from below $76,000 to trade 0.5 percent higher Wednesday as analysts said clearer U.S. midterm election results eased political uncertainty.
   Traders bought hundreds of millions of dollars in bitcoin call options, which wager on rising prices, as election-day options block trading more than doubled from the previous day.
   Markus Thielen, founder of 10x Research, said a momentum indicator suggested bitcoin was oversold and could rebound toward $82,000.
